fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Front Driveway; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Dense Vegetation; Dense Vegetation
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Limited Visibility; Detached Structure Complexity
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can locate the property quickly from the road.

• Trim vegetation along both sides of the driveway to allow emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.

• Cut back dense vegetation near the driveway entrance to improve the line of sight from the road onto the property.

• Mark or number the detached structure so responders arriving on scene can immediately distinguish it from the main residence.

• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings on foot without pushing through vegetation.

• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored items so arriving emergency vehicles have room to stage near the main residence.

• Trim dense vegetation away from the walls of both the main residence and the detached structure so responders can walk the perimeter of each building.

wildfire.conditions: Tree Cluster; Large Trees; Scattered Trees; Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Limited Vegetation Separation; Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Single Access Route; Vegetation Along Driveway
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster closest to the structure to create open space between individual trees and the building.
• Remove or trim shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure's exterior walls.
• Trim low-hanging branches on large trees near the structure to raise the canopy off the ground.
• Separate scattered trees from nearby shrubs by removing shrubs growing beneath or between them.
• Clear dead leaves, twigs, and plant debris from the ground around the structure and along the base of the walls.
• Trim overhanging branches along the driveway to keep the full width and height of the travel path open.
• Remove shrubs and tall grass growing along the edges of the driveway that would narrow vehicle passage.
• Keep the single access route clear of fallen branches, overgrown vegetation, and any debris that could block emergency vehicles.
• Thin scattered trees on the side of the structure where vegetation is densest to open more space around the building.
• Cut back shrubs and low vegetation growing between the tree clusters and the structure to reduce connected plant material leading toward the building.
